.ship is not reversible.

Read the runbook first.

ship a service

This command is in beta: it may change in a minor release.

Usage:
  ops deploy [flags] <service> [COUNT]

Arguments:
  <service>    the service to ship (length 2..63)
  [COUNT]      how many copies (>= 1)

Flags:
  -p, --port int              listen port (default 8080, 1..65535)
      --ratio number          traffic share (> 0, <= 1, experimental)
      --step int              rollout step (multiple of 5)
      --tag string...         a label (1..5 values, length <= 10, repeatable)
      --timeout duration      how long to wait (>= 1s, < 1h)
  -e, --env key=value         extra environment (<= 8 values, repeatable)
      --token string          the deploy token (@file or - for stdin)
      --key string            the signing key (@file)
      --label string...       a label to apply (default [a,b c"d], repeatable)
      --zone string...        the zones to use (default [eu us], repeatable)
      --quote string          the quoting style [a`b|plain]
      --secrets string        read secrets from this file
      --stage string          the stage to deploy to
      --sep string            the field separator (exactly 1 character)
      --points int            story points (1..21)
      --weights key=number    a weight per zone (repeatable)
      --link value            a link to follow
      --pair string...        exactly two hosts (exactly 2 values, repeatable)
      --replicas int          how many to run (default 1, 1..100)
                              also set by OPS_DEPLOY_REPLICAS or config key deploy.replicas
  --token and --key can't be used together
  --ratio and --step must be used together
  with --zone eu, --port is required and --quote can't be used
  unless --key is given, --token is required

Configuration:
  deploy.registry string    the registry to push to (in .ops.yaml)
  deploy.retries int        how many times to retry (default 1, 0..9)

Files:
  ./secrets.json    or the file --secrets names; profiles under "stages", chosen by --stage (default dev)
  ~/.ops.yaml
  .ops.yaml         in the working directory or the nearest parent holding one

Global Flags:
  -h, --help            print help
  -v, --verbose         say more (repeatable)
      --color string    when to color (default auto) [auto|always|never]

Report problems at https://example.com/ops/issues.
